channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: New U.S. F-15EX fighters arrive at Okinawa Kadena Base
item.description: Kadena is the Air Force's first overseas base to receive the fighters equipped with state-of-the-art electronic warfare systems.

item.title: Japan to propose Asian version of IEA at AZEC summit
item.description: The Takaichi administration aims to strengthen Asia's energy supply chains, whose vulnerability was exposed during the ongoing Middle East turmoil.

item.title: As more foreign nationals join Japan’s workforce, diversity policies take on new importance
item.description: In response to changing expectations, Japanese organizations have embraced DEI policies, but hurdles remain toward proper implementation.

item.title: Man arrested in Osaka for alleged abuse, murder of daughter
item.description: According to an expert committee, 50 children died from physical abuse or neglect in Japan in fiscal 2024.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
